# String Array To Path

![String Array To Path function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/conversion/02-array-of-strings-to-path.svg)

[Path functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Builds a path from an array of components.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Tableau de chaines en chemin**

Construit un chemin depuis un tableau de composants. [Types] Un tableau de chaînes exactement 1D et un booléen relatif scalaire facultatif (faux par défaut) produisent un chemin scalaire. Les rangs supérieurs et tableaux de chemins sont refusés.

</details>

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Exactly a 1D String array and an optional scalar relative Boolean (false by default) produce one scalar Path. Higher ranks and arrays of Paths are rejected.

## Types and connection rules

Exactly a 1D String array and an optional scalar relative Boolean (false by default) produce one scalar Path. Higher ranks and arrays of Paths are rejected.

- Type resolution: `fixed`; result expression: `declared_output_type`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `none`.

**Input count:** 2; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.
